+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DocumentServiceConfig:
+    ocr_api_base: str = os.getenv("OCR_API_BASE", "https://api.ocr.space/parse/image")
+    layout_api_base: str = os.getenv("LAYOUT_API_BASE", "https://api.veryfi.com/api/v8/partner/documents")
+    ocr_api_key: Optional[str] = os.getenv("OCR_API_KEY")
+    layout_client_id: Optional[str] = os.getenv("LAYOUT_CLIENT_ID")
+    layout_client_secret: Optional[str] = os.getenv("LAYOUT_CLIENT_SECRET")
+
+
+class OCRClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[DocumentServiceConfig] = None) -> None:
+        self.config = config or DocumentServiceConfig()
+
+    def extract_text(self, image_url: str, language: str = "eng") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        headers = {}
+        if self.config.ocr_api_key:
+            headers["apikey"] = self.config.ocr_api_key
+        response = requests.post(
+            self.config.ocr_api_base,
+            headers=headers,
+            data={"url": image_url, "language": language, "isOverlayRequired": False},
+            timeout=60,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
+
+class LayoutExtractionClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[DocumentServiceConfig] = None) -> None:
+        self.config = config or DocumentServiceConfig()
+
+    def extract_layout(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        if not self.config.layout_client_id or not self.config.layout_client_secret:
+            raise ValueError("LAYOUT_CLIENT_ID and LAYOUT_CLIENT_SECRET are required")
+        response = requests.post(
+            self.config.layout_api_base,
+            auth=(self.config.layout_client_id, self.config.layout_client_secret),
+            files={"file": (filename, file_bytes)},
+            timeout=60,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
+
+def get_document_services() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    config = DocumentServiceConfig()
+    return {"ocr": OCRClient(config), "layout_extraction": LayoutExtractionClient(config), "config": config}
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _fallback_extract(text: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    pairs: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        match = re.match(r"^\s*([^:={\n]+?)\s*[:=]\s*(.+?)\s*$", line)
+        if match:
+            key = match.group(1).strip()
+            value = match.group(2).strip()
+            if key and value:
+                pairs[key] = value
+    return pairs
+
+
+def _build_messages(text: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
+    system = "Extract key-value pairs from the provided form-like document. Return only valid JSON object data."
+    user = f"Document:\n{text}\n\nReturn a JSON object of extracted key-value pairs."
+    return [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
+
+
+def extract_key_values(text: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        return _fallback_extract(text)
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "messages": _build_messages(text),
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(content)
+        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
+            return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in parsed.items()}
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        pass
+    return _fallback_extract(content)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    input_text = sys.stdin.read()
+    result = extract_key_values(input_text)
+    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+
+def _text_from_anchor(document_text: str, text_anchor: Any) -> str:
+    if not text_anchor or not getattr(text_anchor, "text_segments", None):
+        return ""
+    segments = []
+    for segment in text_anchor.text_segments:
+        start_index = int(segment.start_index) if segment.start_index is not None else 0
+        end_index = int(segment.end_index) if segment.end_index is not None else 0
+        segments.append(document_text[start_index:end_index])
+    return "".join(segments)
+
+
+def _normalized_vertices(layout: Any) -> List[Dict[str, float]]:
+    vertices = []
+    for vertex in getattr(layout.bounding_poly, "normalized_vertices", []) or []:
+        vertices.append({"x": float(vertex.x), "y": float(vertex.y)})
+    return vertices
+
+
+def _table_cells(rows: Any, document_text: str) -> List[List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
+    extracted_rows: List[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = []
+    for row in rows:
+        cells: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+        for cell in row.cells:
+            cells.append(
+                {
+                    "text": _text_from_anchor(document_text, cell.layout.text_anchor),
+                    "row_span": int(getattr(cell, "row_span", 1) or 1),
+                    "col_span": int(getattr(cell, "col_span", 1) or 1),
+                    "bounding_poly": _normalized_vertices(cell.layout),
+                }
+            )
+        extracted_rows.append(cells)
+    return extracted_rows
+
+
+def extract_tables(
+    document_path: str,
+    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    location: Optional[str] = None,
+    processor_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    mime_type: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
+    if project_id is None:
+        project_id = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
+    if location is None:
+        location = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION", "us")
+    if processor_id is None:
+        processor_id = os.environ.get("DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID")
+    if mime_type is None:
+        mime_type = os.environ.get("DOCUMENT_AI_MIME_TYPE", "application/pdf")
+
+    if not project_id or not processor_id:
+        raise ValueError("project_id and processor_id are required")
+
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
+    processor_name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)
+
+    with open(document_path, "rb") as file:
+        raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=file.read(), mime_type=mime_type)
+
+    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=processor_name, raw_document=raw_document)

+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+
+
+def extract_text(image_path: str) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    path = Path(image_path)
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(image_path)
+
+    mime = "image/png"
+    suffix = path.suffix.lower()
+    if suffix in {".jpg", ".jpeg"}:
+        mime = "image/jpeg"
+    elif suffix == ".webp":
+        mime = "image/webp"
+    elif suffix == ".gif":
+        mime = "image/gif"
+
+    image_b64 = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("utf-8")
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Extract all readable plain text from this scanned document image. Return only the text."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:{mime};base64,{image_b64}"},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    texts = []
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                text = content.get("text")
+                if text:
+                    texts.append(text)
+
+    return "\n".join(texts).strip()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("image_path")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    sys.stdout.write(extract_text(args.image_path))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
